The '''second battle''' at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]] was an event during the [[Jedi Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. At Iridonia, the two sides fought with the Republic emerging as the victors.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Second Battle of Iridonia makes its only appearance in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EA" /> An exact date is not provided for the battle, and it only illustrates the battle on the galactic map rather than in prose. The [[Battle of Iridonia (Jedi Civil War)|other battle]] at Iridonia is also illustrated on the map, marking a Sith victory<ref name="EA" /> which appears in the ''[[Wizards of the Coast]]'' supplement {{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/iridonian|text=Iridonian Darkness|int=Iridonian Darkness}}.<ref name="ID">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/iridonian|text=Iridonian Darkness|int=Iridonian Darkness}}</ref> This battle, however, is placed at the front-end of the war, sometime in [[3958 BBY]], following the [[bombing of Telos IV]].<ref name="ID" /> The second battle takes place at a time which has not been canonically solidified.
